parsed.name: SPEC服务器客户端
parsed.description: 用于连接实验站 SPEC 服务器的非实体软件组件。它可向远程 SPEC 会话发送命令、切换和创建目录、访问变量/电机/计数器对象，并等待系统就绪或计数完成，常用于束线或实验控制流程中的自动化脚本协调。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for connecting to a beamline SPEC server. It sends commands to a remote SPEC session, changes or creates directories, accesses variables, motors, and counters, and waits for readiness or counting to complete. It is typically used to coordinate experiment automation workflows.
